body: As I gaze at the fresh footprints, my blood starts to boil. I think about the person who could have made these marks, wondering if they've been ignoring the garden and trampling over the plants I've so carefully nurtured. I decide to confront the person directly, hoping to avoid a confrontation but willing to stand up for my lawn.
